verdict.rationale: GitHub claims an 'Interactive playground to test and generate request code' (gh-21) and docs contain code snippets (docs-1, docs-8), but there is no confirmed OpenAPI/Swagger spec or browsable interactive reference—probes for openapi.json/swagger.json on the docs domain all 404 (probe-2), suggesting any playground lives only on a self-hosted server instance rather than a public interactive API reference.
